card.name: Duration words in treatment-length phrases
card.fires_on: Words inside phrases about how long something lasts or continues, such as "for as long as necessary", "continue for a total", "up to 2 years" or "longer than one week after". Mostly in drug-label text on overdose, therapy length or elimination.

modes.label: Duration phrases
modes.description: A word in the middle of a phrase about how long care, therapy or a drug effect lasts.
modes.example: General symptomatic and supportive measures should be instituted promptly and maintained for as<< long>> as necessary.

modes.label: Time span after 'up to'
modes.description: The space or number slot right before a time span such as 2 years.
modes.example: Without use of an accelerated drug elimination procedure, it may take up to<< >>2 years to reach undetectable plasma
